title: Ambient balanced derived tensors commute with scalar reindexing
statement: Fix l prime, an arbitrary scheme isomorphism g:X→Y, native realizations R,S, a function-normalized RingReindex B, finite fields E≤L, and independently normalized IntegralReindex data IE,IL. For every ambient derived integral module K at E on Y, a_X(G_E K)^−1≫nativeExtend_R,L(b_K)≫IL.derived^−1(T_Y K) = IE.derived^−1(K)≫derivedPull(B)(a_Y(K)^−1). Here T is ordinary universal derived scalar extension, G is ordinary completed-ring inverse image, b is the explicitly constructed completedScalarReindex from [def-sf-adic-reindex-scalar-maps], and a_X,a_Y are pbcReductionNormalization for the coefficient_scalar equations. There is no constructibility, completion map, common-stage category, invertibility-of-l hypothesis, or realization integral comparison in this square.

proof.text: Choose a flat-term K-flat representative of K. Use IE.representative and IL.representative to express their derived components through pbcComplexCounit, the exact inverse-image factors, and their cochain balance maps. Expand the normalized scalar model and pbcReductionNormalization through their universal cochain counits.

proof.text: At a site object apply the section formulas of IE and IL to a pure coefficient tensor. Both composites reindex the same section x and multiply the same scalars. R.coefficient_scalar and S.coefficient_scalar identify the composed structural maps, and B.functions fixes reindexing of the coefficient functions. Associativity of multiplication and the balanced tensor relation identify the two section values. Pure tensors generate the presheaf tensor, so the sheafification universal property gives equality of module maps; degreewise extensionality gives equality of cochain maps.

proof.text: The representative equations and natural cochain counits descend this equality through the good-complex localization. Transport along the representative isomorphism gives the formula for every ambient K. This argument uses ordinary scalar tensors throughout and never cancels an ambient completion unit.

lean.statement:
theorem integralReindex_balanced_scalar (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    (R : LocallyFiniteAdicRealization.Realization l X)
    (S : LocallyFiniteAdicRealization.Realization l Y)
    (B : RingReindex l X g R S)
    (E L : Index l (PadicAlgCl l)) (h : E ≤ L)
    (IE : IntegralReindex l X g B E) (IL : IntegralReindex l X g B L)
    (K : DerivedCategory (integralTowerModules l (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) Y)) :
    let i := coefficientInclusion l (PadicAlgCl l) E L h
    let C := Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l)
    let aX := pbcReductionNormalization (completedCoefficientMap l (C E) (C L) i X)
      (coefficientMap l X R L) (coefficientMap l X R E) (R.coefficient_scalar E L h)
    let aY := pbcReductionNormalization (completedCoefficientMap l (C E) (C L) i Y)
      (coefficientMap l Y S L) (coefficientMap l Y S E) (S.coefficient_scalar E L h)
    (aX ((podCompletedDerivedInverseImage l (C E) g).obj K)).inv ≫
      (pbcDerivedExtend (coefficientMap l X R L)).map
        ((completedScalarReindex l (C E) (C L) i g).hom.app K) ≫
      IL.derived.inv.app ((completedDerivedScalarExtension l (C E) (C L) i Y).obj K) =
    IE.derived.inv.app K ≫ (derivedPull l X g B).map (aY K).inv
